mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered sliding cycle was most worthwhile: it connects ATP use to pulling and distinguishes sliding filaments from shortening filaments.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the two muscles was somewhat repetitive, although their different head and tendon arrangements added anatomical detail.

surprise.text: Relaxation requires ATP-powered calcium pumping, and the fibre lengthens under an outside pull rather than actively pushing itself longer.

arbitrary.text: The order of building and attaching biceps versus triceps felt like a preference rather than a consequential decision; both were needed for the goal.

continue.text: I would continue: the progression from filament movement to opposing movements at the elbow made the constructions worth following, despite some predictable assembly.
